item.title: Influencers in Dubai claim it's 'safer here' than US, despite Iran attacks
item.summary: Dubai influencers say they feel safer than major US cities amid Middle East conflict, as UAE intercepts hundreds of missiles targeting the destination.

item.title: Schumer knocks Trump on Iran, plan to send ICE to airports: 'Asking for trouble'
item.summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer called President Donald Trump's plan to deploy ICE agents to U.S. airports "impulsive" on Sunday.

item.title: Analysts say Gaza 'civilian' deaths include Hamas, other terror members working as medics, media workers
item.summary: Researchers say Hamas and PIJ martyr lists reveal Gaza terrorists who posed as doctors, nurses and journalists, clouding civilian casualty figures.

item.title: Waltz says Trump is using Iran's own oil strategy against itself to drive down global prices
item.summary: The U.S. lifts sanctions on 140 million barrels of Iranian oil at sea, while keeping bank sanctions in place to deny Tehran the revenue.

item.title: YouTube job scam text: How to spot it fast
item.summary: YouTube job scams sent via text are spreading globally, Google warns. Learn the key warning signs, including unrealistic pay and requests to move chats to Telegram or WhatsApp.

item.title: Mamdani's estate tax plan could drive wealth out of state, critics warn
item.summary: NYC Mayor Mamdani's estate tax plan would cut the exemption to $750K and raise rates to 50%, a move critics say could burden middle-class families.

item.title: Trump mocks 'discombobulated' Schumer over Democrats' near gaffe on funding ICE
item.summary: President Donald Trump mocked Chuck Schumer after the Senate minority leader accidentally said "We must fund ICE" on the Senate floor amid the DHS funding shutdown fight.

item.title: NHL writer, 3 children die in Minnesota house fire, officials say
item.summary: Minnesota Wild reporter Jessi Pierce and her three children were tragically killed in a house fire in Minnesota on Saturday. Tributes poured out on social media for her.

item.title: Brooks Koepka runs to comfort young girl hit by golf cart during his Valspar Championship
item.summary: Brooks Koepka rushed to comfort a young girl struck by a golf cart during Saturday's round at the Valspar Championship, with reports saying she was OK after evaluation.

item.title: Far-left activists stay in 5-star Cuban hotel as island suffers total blackout
item.summary: CodePink sponsored flights to Cuba to protest President Donald Trump's sanctions, but the group faced backlash for staying in luxury hotels.
